name: grc_smoke
description: Synthetic GRC phone-call checks for language choice, short turns, and noisy bin-address transcripts.

scenarios.description: Short language preference should be accepted immediately.
expectations: caller transcript contains English please or a rewritten English language preference
agent does not ask for language preference again

scenarios.description: One-word language answer should not need extra words.
expectations: caller transcript contains English or a rewritten English language preference
agent continues without waiting for another caller phrase

scenarios.description: Clean Warraba Street bin lookup path.
utterances: My address is fifty Warraba Street Hurstville
expectations: agent asks to confirm the matched address before giving bin collection days

scenarios.description: Common STT failure where Warraba becomes warboss.
utterances: My address is fifty warboss street Hurstville
expectations: agent corrects warboss street to Warraba Street
agent asks to confirm Warraba Street before giving bin collection days

scenarios.description: Agent should hear ordinary short phrases without requiring multiple repeats.
expectations: caller transcript includes the short phrases as separate turns or a timely combined turn
agent responds rather than silently waiting for extra speech

scenarios.description: Filler words should not make the real address disappear.
utterances: It is fifty Vine Street Hurstville
expectations: agent stays silent or brief during hesitation
agent captures fifty Vine Street Hurstville after the hesitation
